razao: Openstacks is highly challenging for standard delete-relaxation heuristics because they ignore the resource limitations (open stacks), making the relaxed plan trivial and uninformative. Planners that incorporate width-based/novelty search (like P21) excel in such domains by exploring the state space structurally, and the portfolio architecture ensures maximum coverage.
